artDirection: Modern pixel-art/HD-2D. Canonical moonlit Lion camp and protected V2 identities; final silent authored motion must pass separate visual/runtime acceptance.

shots.purpose: A rare major departure: the small company physically starts toward the existing route through the grand camp/valley environment.

camera.intent: Locked scenic camera for this targeted pixel-construction test; purposeful physical walking and active cloth/fire/banner/river carry the scene. Keep the established world pixels stable; no pan, zoom, orbit, new framing or new world surfaces.

shots.promptIntent: Animate this exact image as a modern PIXEL-ART / HD-2D cinematic with intentionally discrete pixel clusters and stepped contours. Preserve the original pixel-art construction on every actor, ornament and world surface; never redraw them as smooth vector/anime/3D illustration. Camera is locked, while the three actors remain active: 0-2 seconds, one readable weight shift and first grounded step; 2-10 seconds, continuous purposeful screen-right walking with alternating feet, body weight transfer, cloth/cape inertia and equipment contact; 10-12 seconds, decelerate into an alive stable formation within the existing camp street. Travel only a modest span inside this authored composition so all three full bodies remain readable; no exit or new destination. Marian keeps her star staff; Maelor clamps his book in its source hand visibly against his chest throughout, never lowers, transfers, straps, hides or dissolves it; preserve his dagger. Alistair carries the source greatsword low without attacking. Exact helmets/veil/hood/mask/colors/proportions. Wind moves banners and capes, fire flickers, sparks rise and river ripples: all are actual independent motion, never a still zoom. The small silver CRESCENT moon retains exact phase, size and place relative to the castle, aqueduct, mountains and river. No new bridge/cart/room, geography reconstruction, full moon, sunrise, exposed face, actor, magic, combat, outcome, text, speech, UI or audio. Final frame retains all original equipment and pixel detail, then the existing covered STATIC_TABLEAU transfers agency. This camera variant is an isolated style/identity test; no production acceptance is implied.
